title: VPN won't connect (GlobalProtect)
steps: Confirm you have internet access by opening any public website.
Quit GlobalProtect fully from the system tray and reopen it.
Set the portal to vpn.corp.example.com and sign in with SSO.
If you see 'gateway unreachable', switch from Wi-Fi to a mobile hotspot to rule out your home router.
Still failing? Restart your laptop, then reply here and I'll open a network ticket.

title: Account lockout policy and self-service unlock
steps: Accounts lock after 5 failed sign-in attempts and auto-unlock after 30 minutes.
The assistant can unlock your own account immediately after identity verification.
Update saved passwords on your phone (mail app, Wi-Fi) to avoid re-locking.
Repeated lockouts within 24 hours are reviewed by IT Security.

title: Password reset and complexity rules
steps: Passwords must be 14+ characters and cannot reuse your last 10 passwords.
A reset link is sent to your registered recovery email/phone and expires in 15 minutes.
IT staff will never ask you for your password.
After resetting, sign out and back in on all devices.

title: Set up or replace MFA (Microsoft Authenticator)
steps: Go to mysignins.corp.example.com > Security info.
Choose Add method > Authenticator app and scan the QR code.
Approve the test notification on your phone.
Lost your old phone? Ask the assistant to escalate - an MFA reset requires identity verification by a technician.

title: Outlook not syncing or stuck 'Updating folder'
steps: Check webmail at outlook.office.com - if mail is there, the issue is your desktop client.
In Outlook, go to File > Account Settings > Repair.
Close Outlook, then rename %localappdata%\Microsoft\Outlook\*.ost to *.old and reopen.
If your mailbox is over 98% full, archive or delete large items.

title: Office Wi-Fi (CorpSecure) connection issues
steps: Forget the CorpSecure network and reconnect using your SSO credentials.
Make sure the device certificate is present (Company Portal > Sync).
Use CorpGuest only for personal devices - it has no internal access.
If multiple people on your floor are affected, report it as an outage.

title: Laptop running slow
steps: Restart - many slowdowns are pending updates waiting on a reboot.
Open Task Manager and close apps using high CPU or memory.
Make sure at least 15% disk space is free.
Run Company Portal > Sync to finish pending patches.
If the laptop is older than 4 years, ask the assistant about a hardware refresh.

title: Printing to office printers (FollowMe)
steps: Print to the 'FollowMe' queue from any app.
Tap your badge on any office printer to release the job.
If the queue is missing, run Company Portal > Install 'FollowMe Printing'.
Paper jams and toner: use the printer's QR code to report the device.

title: Requesting software
steps: Free, pre-approved apps install from Company Portal without approval.
Licensed software needs your manager's approval; the assistant files this for you.
Software not in the catalog requires a Security review (5 business days).
Peer-to-peer and remote-control tools are prohibited.

title: Teams audio or camera not working
steps: In Teams, go to Settings > Devices and select the correct speaker, mic and camera.
Check the OS privacy settings allow Teams to use the mic and camera.
Unplug and reconnect your headset, then make a test call.
Clear the Teams cache: quit Teams, delete %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams\Cache, restart.

title: Reporting phishing or a security incident
steps: Do not click further links or open attachments.
Disconnect from the network if you suspect malware is running.
Use the 'Report Phishing' button in Outlook.
Security has been paged - stay available for a call.
